chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: official paid media separate fresh-upload runtime preflight

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'BOT_API_BINARY='; (command -v telegram-bot-api || true)
printf 'BOT_API_IMAGE='; (docker images --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}' | grep -E 'telegram-bot-api|aiogram/telegram-bot-api' | head -n 1 || true)
printf 'BOT_API_CONTAINER='; (docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'telegram-bot-api' | head -n 2 || true)
printf 'CREATOR_CONTAINER='; (docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E 'createvdobot.*poll|videobot-poll' | head -n 2 || true)
printf 'CREDENTIAL_NAMES_PRESENT='; (env | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E '^(TELEGRAM_API_ID|TELEGRAM_API_HASH|TG_API_ID|TG_API_HASH)$' | tr '\n' ',' || true); echo
printf 'ORIGINAL_VIDEO_CANDIDATE_BYTES='; (find /mnt/g /mnt/G /home/gace/Project/Gserver -type f -iname '*.mp4' -size +1000M -printf '%s\n' 2>/dev/null | head -n 3 | tr '\n' ',' || true); echo
printf 'LOCAL_COMPOSE_EXISTS='; (test -f deploy/compose.videobot.local-media.yaml && echo yes || echo no)
